generated_by.method: web search + page reads; official sources preferred. Counts are for the whole Gulf research session (shared across ae/sa/qa and research later dropped for bh/kw/om); pages_read = 7 full pages via WebFetch + robots.txt of 20 job-site hosts via curl. Several official pages (mohre.gov.ae, saudieng.sa, sapr.gov.sa, mol.gov.qa) timed out or refused automated fetches.

open_questions: Whether the AED 30,000 Golden Visa threshold is basic salary or total salary outside Dubai (ADDED page does not say; Vialto June 2026 says Dubai requires basic salary, excluding allowances, plus 2+ years with current employer).
Whether a 3-year Indian BCA is accepted as 'bachelor's or equivalent' for MOHRE skill levels 1-3 / Green and Golden visas without extra evaluation (not found on an official page).
General employment residence visa: official fee schedule and processing time from ICP/MOHRE (mohre.gov.ae unreachable during research).
Exact rules of MOHRE establishment classification (categories 1-3) and whether any list is public.
Senior SWE salary: sources disagree widely (Indeed ~AED 9.5k/month from postings, PayScale ~AED 224k/year base, Jooble ~AED 28k/month); no Cooper Fitch/Hays tech figures could be read.
Typical relocation package contents (housing, schooling, flights) are not sourced in this research.
Robots/ToS of Naukrigulf and Laimoon could not be retrieved; Dubizzle and GulfTalent ToS not reviewed.

name: United Arab Emirates

languages.note: English is the working language of most private-sector tech teams; Arabic is a plus for government/semi-government roles (general observation, not sourced).

salary.note: Bounded by two published averages, not percentiles: low = Indeed senior software engineer average AED 9,457/month x 12 (job-posting based, updated 2026-09-30); high = PayScale senior software engineer average base AED 223,924/year (2026). Indeed senior developer averages AED 10,039/month; Jooble posting-based average ~AED 28,451/month (~AED 341k/year) suggests strong candidates at product companies can exceed the high value. Gulf offers are often split into basic + housing + transport allowances; check whether a quoted figure is basic or total. Approximate, low confidence.

income_tax_note: 0% personal income tax on salaries (general knowledge, not re-verified this session); 5% VAT applies to goods/services and government fees (GDRFA fee page quotes '+5% VAT').
cost_of_living_note: Housing is the dominant cost, especially in Dubai; employers typically quote packages with a housing allowance. No sourced figures gathered.

visa_routes.name: Employer-sponsored work permit + employment residence visa

salary_threshold.note: No general minimum salary found for the standard work permit.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: Not strictly required for a work permit, but the MOHRE occupational skill level (1-9) recorded on the permit depends on attested qualifications; skill levels 1-3 (needed for Green/Golden visas) require at least a bachelor's or equivalent.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: A BCA is a bachelor's degree; it must be attested (Indian state HRD/university -> MEA apostille/attestation -> UAE embassy -> UAE MOFA) to be used for skill-level classification. Official confirmation that 3-year degrees are treated as 'bachelor's or equivalent' was not found - open question.
visa_routes.lottery_or_quota: No lottery. Emiratisation: private establishments with 50+ employees must raise Emirati share of skilled jobs by 2 percentage points a year to 10% by end-2026 (half-year steps of 1%); firms with 20-49 staff in 14 activities, including information and communications, have targets too. Non-compliant firms pay contributions and can be downgraded in MOHRE's establishment classification. Affects hiring mix but does not bar foreign tech hires.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: No permanent residency; long-term options are the 5-year Green Visa and 10-year Golden Visa (renewable).
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: Employer bears recruitment and visa costs; MOHRE says genuine employers cover all recruitment costs and job seekers should never pay to secure a job. Fee amounts not confirmed on an official page this session.

visa_routes.name: Green Visa - high-level skilled employee (5-year, self-sponsored residence)

salary_threshold.note: GDRFA: salary at least AED 15,000 or equivalent; basic vs total not specified on the page.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: Bachelor's degree or equivalent, minimum; MOHRE occupational skill level 1, 2 or 3; MOHRE high-level skilled worker permit / approved employment contract.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: BCA should count as a bachelor's but must be attested; no official statement on 3-year degrees found.
visa_routes.path_to_pr: No PR; renewable 5-year residence not tied to employer sponsorship.
visa_routes.employer_cost_note: GDRFA lists work visa fee AED 200 + 5% VAT; if already in-country, Knowledge Dirham AED 10, Innovation Dirham AED 10 and in-country fee AED 500. Totals vary by case.

visa_routes.name: Golden Visa - skilled professional (10-year)

salary_threshold.note: Abu Dhabi (ADDED): AED 30,000/month shown by salary certificate + 6 months' bank statements. Dubai (Vialto alert 2026-06-12): AED 30,000 BASIC salary, excluding housing/transport allowances, plus >2 years continuous employment with current employer.

visa_routes.degree_requirement: Attested bachelor's degree or equivalent; role classified at MOHRE occupational level 1 (managers) or 2 (professionals incl. IT); UAE-approved employment contract.
visa_routes.three_year_indian_bachelors_note: BCA must be attested; whether 3-year degrees qualify as 'equivalent' not confirmed officially.

sponsor_register.name: No public sponsor register. Company-licence check: National Economic Register (NER, now under growth.gov.ae). Offer check: MOHRE job-offer serial number/barcode.
sponsor_register.how_to_use: Any licensed UAE establishment may sponsor. Link the user to NER to confirm the employer's trade licence exists; tell users to verify any offer letter's MOHRE serial number/barcode on the MOHRE website/app or call 600590000. No bulk download found, so no automatic name matching.

negative: candidates currently in the country only

ease_for_indian_nationals.rationale: Largest Gulf tech job market with English-speaking teams and a very large Indian workforce; all hiring is employer-sponsored but that is routine. Green Visa (AED 15k) and Golden Visa (AED 30k) give employer-independent options for well-paid seniors. Main friction is degree attestation and confirming a 3-year BCA is classified as bachelor's-level.

factors.degree_recognition: Bachelor's or equivalent required for MOHRE skill levels 1-3; attestation needed; 3-year degree treatment not confirmed.
factors.processing_speed: Fast for long-term visas (Green Visa 48h per GDRFA); standard work visa time not confirmed.
factors.quota_or_lottery: No lottery; Emiratisation targets apply to firms with 50+ (and some 20-49) staff but do not block foreign hires.
factors.employer_willingness: High; employer sponsorship is the norm for expatriate hiring (general observation).
factors.attestation_or_paperwork: Degree attestation chain (state/university -> MEA -> UAE embassy -> UAE MOFA) required for skilled classification.

relocation_norms: Employer sponsorship of the visa is standard and employers bear recruitment/visa costs (MOHRE). Packages commonly quote basic salary plus housing and transport allowances; flights, schooling and family sponsorship vary by employer and seniority - not sourced in this research.

communities.name: Consulate General of India, Dubai
communities.note: Attestation and welfare services for northern emirates.

scam_warnings: MOHRE: genuine offers use the ministry's approved job-offer form with a unique serial number and barcode; verify on the MOHRE website/app or call 600590000 before accepting.
Never work on a visit visa: UAE authorities state visit visas do not permit work; wait for an approved work visa.
Confirm the employer is licensed via the National Economic Register; report fraud to police (e.g. Dubai Police e-crime platform or 999).
Any request for money (visa fee, processing fee, 'deposit', medical or 'security' fee) before or after an offer is a red flag; MOHRE states genuine employers cover all recruitment costs.
Offers that ask you to travel or start work on a visit/tourist visa: visit visas do not permit work; India's MEA says a genuine offer must allow emigration on an employment/work visa.

Unregistered Indian recruiting agents: MEA advisories report job seekers cheated by unregistered agents, with overcharging of roughly Rs 2-5 lakh; check the agent's licence number on the eMigrate 'List of active RA' (https://emigrate.gov.in/ext/raList.action).
A genuine overseas offer (per MEA) carries an employment contract signed by the foreign employer, the recruitment agent and the worker.
MEA (Aug 2023) warned that some agents misused foreign employers' eMigrate logins to generate fake offers, so an eMigrate-looking document alone is not proof.

App-detectable signals: fee/deposit keywords ('processing fee', 'visa charges', 'refundable deposit'), free-mail recruiter domains (gmail/yahoo/outlook) claiming to be a large company, WhatsApp/Telegram-only contact, no company name or address, salary far above market, 'immediate hiring, no interview', early requests for passport scans or bank details, and 'free visa' / 'visa for sale' wording ('فيزا حرة', 'إقامة حرة').
